name: Appalaraju
reason: Used in coastal Andhra (Appalaswamy devotion); meaning was vague. State tag should be AP.

fix.meaning_en: King Appala; Appala is a Telugu name for the deity (Appalaswamy, Narasimha of Simhachalam)

name: Chalapathi
reason: Real Telugu name (Andhra); the 'lord of the moving' gloss is shaky.

fix.meaning_en: Lord of the moving (cala + pati); etymology uncertain

name: Channakeshava
reason: Karnataka name (Belur Chennakeshava); IAST did not match the Devanagari as written.

fix.meaning_en: Beautiful Keshava (Kannada cenna, beautiful); Vishnu of Belur

name: Dharmaraj
reason: Used in Karnataka and Tamil Nadu; Yama reference is unsuitable for a given name. Note: state tag may be wider than AP/TS/KA.

fix.meaning_en: King of righteousness; epithet of Yudhishthira

name: Gurunath
reason: Used in Karnataka and Maharashtra; sound meaning. Note: state tag may be Maharashtra rather than south.

name: Halesh
reason: Karnataka name; IAST lacked final vowel and Balarama gloss is doubtful.

fix.meaning_en: Lord of the plough (hala + īśa); etymology uncertain

name: Jagan
reason: Common Telugu name (Jagan Mohan); world-lord short form.

name: Kameswara
reason: Telugu form of Kameshvara, Shiva; common in AP/TS.

name: Kiccha
reason: epithet_not_given_name: Kannada film nickname, not a traditional given name; no sound Sanskrit meaning.

name: Kishan
reason: Northern spelling; Devanagari and IAST were wrong (कृष्ण sounds as kiśan). State tag looks northern (not AP/TS/KA only).

name: Krishnamohan
reason: Used in Andhra and Karnataka; auspicious Krishna name.

name: Krishnappa
reason: Common Kannada name; appa is a Kannada honorific suffix.

name: Lakshmipathi
reason: Common southern spelling; Vishnu.

name: Nagabhushan
reason: Used in Karnataka and Telugu states; Shiva epithet as name.

name: Rajasekhar
reason: Very common Telugu name; meaning wrongly mentions poet.

fix.meaning_en: Crest-jewel of kings (rāja + śekhara); also Shiva

name: Ramu
reason: Affectionate short form of Rama, widely used in the south.

name: Sesha
reason: Used in Telugu states (Seshagiri, Sesha Reddy); serpent Shesha of Vishnu.

name: Sharath
reason: Karnataka spelling; Devanagari did not reflect the written final th.

name: Siddaraju
reason: Karnataka name; meaning loosely worded.

fix.meaning_en: King of the siddhas (perfected ones); from the Siddharameshwara tradition

name: Sivaprasad
reason: Telugu spelling; grace of Shiva.

name: Somashekar
reason: Karnataka and Telugu name; Shiva with the moon on his crest.

name: Srikanth
reason: Common Telugu name; Devanagari श्रीकान्त did not match IAST kaṇṭha.

fix.meaning_en: Of the auspicious throat (śrī + kaṇṭha); Shiva

name: Srikar
reason: Used in Telugu states; bringer of prosperity.

name: Subba
reason: other: Short nickname fragment of Subrahmanya, used only inside compounds like Subba Rao.

name: Tirupati
reason: Given name in AP/TS (Tirupathi Rao); also a place name but accepted for Venkateswara.

name: Varaprasad
reason: Common Telugu name; boon-grace.

name: Venugopal
reason: Common across all southern states; Krishna.
